title: Understanding Software Engineering Agents: A Study of Thought-Action-Result Trajectories
paper_type_zh: 软件工程 agent 轨迹数据发布与混合方法实证研究
best_for_zh: 研究 agent trajectory、软件修复行为、反馈利用、失败模式和轨迹发布审计的读者
one_line: Releases and analyzes 120 RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover, and OpenHands episodes as 2,822 thought-action-result iterations with action and semantic-relation labels, while replay metadata and an immutable release remain incomplete.
该研究把 3 个软件工程 agent 的 120 条成功/失败运行统一为 2,822 次 thought-action-result 迭代，并加入动作与语义关系标注；它适合评测与审计，但缺少可重放环境和不可变发布。
why: The work makes agent behavior auditable below the final patch by separating tool feedback, human semantic judgments, and episode success; it is evidence for evaluation and failure analysis, not evidence of a validated training recipe.
inclusion_reason: It exposes successful and failed software-engineering agent episodes as thought-action-result trajectories with per-step action categories, semantic relationship labels, and heterogeneous terminal-success contracts, making it a concrete environment/agent-trajectory audit resource.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary records are the ASE 2025 Research Papers entry, DOI 10.1109/ASE63991.2025.00234, and arXiv:2506.18824 v2 dated 2025-10-08. The paper asks how software-engineering agents reach a patch and why individual runs succeed or fail, rather than treating the final resolved rate as a complete account of agent behavior. Its official GitHub repository releases parsed trajectories and annotations for inspection.

The concrete gap is methodological: RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover V1, and OpenHands CodeAct emit different logs, tool interfaces, and stopping behavior, so their internal decision processes are difficult to compare directly. The study maps them to a common episode representation, T=[(t1,a1,r1),...,(tn,an,rn)], where a thought is natural-language reasoning, an action invokes a tool or external operation, and a result is the returned observation. It then analyzes structure, action sequences, and semantic coherence for successful and failed runs.

The analysis sample contains 120 episodes and 2,822 iterations: 40 RepairAgent runs on Defects4J, 40 AutoCodeRover V1 runs on SWE-bench Lite, and 40 OpenHands CodeAct runs on SWE-bench Lite. Approximately 10 successful episodes are retained per agent. Released episode material is distributed across parsed thought/action/result text views and CSVs containing instance IDs, iteration and token counts, resolved status, eight-way action categories, and five adjacent-component relation families; it is not one normalized replay record.

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the central object is an agent episode whose feedback comes from tools, benchmark environments, and a terminal success predicate. It is not a new benchmark, agent-training method, reward model, or causal comparison of the three systems. Its supported role is evaluation and failure audit: the paper does not train a policy or demonstrate that these traces are safe training data.

The source material supports L4-depth screening of the object, construction pipeline, labels, and audit risks, while the accepted metadata remains L3_summary_ready. The boundary matters: the repository is real and inspectable, but exact replay, immutable versioning, record-level lineage, dataset rights, and the RepairAgent manifest mismatch remain unresolved.

主要来源包括 ASE 2025 Research Papers 会议记录、DOI 10.1109/ASE63991.2025.00234，以及日期为 2025-10-08 的 arXiv:2506.18824 v2。论文关注软件工程 agent 如何形成补丁、单次运行为何成功或失败，而不是把最终 resolved rate 当成对 agent 行为的完整解释。官方 GitHub 仓库公开了可检查的解析轨迹和标注。

具体缺口在于缺少统一分析方法：RepairAgent、AutoCodeRover V1 和 OpenHands CodeAct 的日志、工具接口与停止方式不同，内部决策过程难以直接比较。研究把三者映射为统一 episode 表示 T=[(t1,a1,r1),...,(tn,an,rn)]：thought 是自然语言推理，action 是工具调用或外部操作，result 是返回的 observation；随后比较成功与失败运行的结构、动作序列和语义一致性。

分析样本包含 120 个 episode、2,822 次迭代：RepairAgent 在 Defects4J 上 40 条，AutoCodeRover V1 在 SWE-bench Lite 上 40 条，OpenHands CodeAct 在 SWE-bench Lite 上 40 条；每个 agent 约保留 10 条成功 episode。公开材料分散在解析后的 thought/action/result 文本视图与 CSV 中，包含 instance ID、迭代/token 计数、resolved 状态、八类 action 和五类相邻组件关系；它不是一张标准化、可直接重放的记录表。

该论文属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为核心对象是 agent episode，反馈来自工具、benchmark environment 与终止成功判据。它不是新 benchmark、agent-training 方法、reward model，也不能用于三种系统的因果性能比较。证据支持的用途仅为 evaluation 与 failure audit；论文没有训练 policy，也没有证明这些轨迹适合直接训练复用。

现有来源足以把数据对象、构造流程、标签和审计风险写到 L4 正文深度，但 accepted metadata 仍保留 L3_summary_ready。这一区分很重要：仓库真实且可检查，但精确 replay、不可变版本、逐记录 lineage、数据权利，以及 RepairAgent 清单不一致问题仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a common thought-action-result lens for comparing heterogeneous software-engineering agent runs below the final patch. The authors convert three agents' logs into ordered interaction triples, measure structural properties, map actions into a shared taxonomy, mine repeated action sequences, and manually label how adjacent thoughts, actions, and results relate.

The data object is a full episode plus analytical views. At episode level it carries the agent and benchmark instance, an ordered sequence of thought, action/tool call, arguments, and result/observation, iteration and token totals, and a binary resolved outcome. At process level it adds one of eight action categories—Explore, Locate, Search, Reproduce, Generate Fix, Run tests, Refactor, or Explain—and labels five relation families: thought-action, thought-thought, action-action, result-thought, and result-action. Frequent-sequence analysis uses action 4-grams.

The feedback contract is deliberately mixed. During a run, tools and the repository environment return observations, but those observations are not per-step correctness labels. At episode end, AutoCodeRover and OpenHands are successful when a patch passes SWE-bench tests. RepairAgent first needs a Defects4J-plausible patch and then manual confirmation that it equals or is semantically equivalent to the developer patch. The action categories and semantic-relation labels are human analytical judgments, not rewards emitted by the environment.

This contract can observe tool feedback, terminal test outcomes, and human-coded coherence between adjacent components. It cannot establish whether a thought is faithful to hidden model computation, whether a passing patch is generally correct beyond the benchmark tests, or whether a relation label has objective ground truth. The paper reports collaborative discussion and partial agreement checks, but not a numeric agreement statistic or a complete double-coding protocol.

Relative to the original RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover, and OpenHands evaluations, the change is to retain and compare internal trajectories instead of only terminal success. Relative to interpretability centered on a single prediction, it studies behavior across time; relative to work that learns from past trajectories, it supplies an empirical audit methodology rather than an optimizer. The direction signal is the combination of successful and failed episodes, a shared action vocabulary, and explicit feedback-use labels—not the introduction of new tasks or new agents.

本文的贡献是用统一的 thought-action-result 视角，在最终补丁之下比较异构软件工程 agent 运行。作者把三种 agent 的日志转换为有序交互三元组，统计结构属性，把 action 映射到同一分类体系，挖掘重复动作序列，并人工标注相邻 thought、action 与 result 之间的关系。

数据对象由完整 episode 及其分析视图组成。episode 级字段包括 agent、benchmark instance、有序的 thought、action/tool call、参数、result/observation、迭代与 token 总量，以及二元 resolved 结果。process 级字段加入八类 action：Explore、Locate、Search、Reproduce、Generate Fix、Run tests、Refactor、Explain；同时标注五类关系：thought-action、thought-thought、action-action、result-thought、result-action。频繁序列分析使用 action 4-gram。

反馈契约是混合型的。运行过程中，工具和仓库 environment 返回 observation，但这些 observation 不是逐步正确性标签。episode 结束时，AutoCodeRover 与 OpenHands 的成功条件是补丁通过 SWE-bench 测试；RepairAgent 则先要求 Defects4J-plausible patch，再由人工确认它与开发者补丁相同或语义等价。action category 与语义关系标签来自人工分析判断，并不是 environment 发出的 reward。

该契约能观察工具反馈、终止测试结果，以及人工编码的相邻组件一致性；它不能证明 thought 忠实反映模型隐藏计算，不能证明通过测试的补丁在 benchmark tests 之外普遍正确，也不能把关系标签当成客观 ground truth。论文报告双方讨论与 partial agreement checks，但没有数值一致性统计或完整 double-coding 协议。

相较 RepairAgent、AutoCodeRover 和 OpenHands 的原始评测，本文改变之处是保留并比较内部轨迹，而不只看终止成功。相较聚焦单次预测的 interpretability，它研究跨时间行为；相较从历史轨迹学习的工作，它提供实证审计方法而不是 optimizer。方向性价值来自成功与失败 episode、共享动作词表和显式反馈利用标签的组合，而不是新任务或新 agent。

title: Method
方法
html:
The input pool consists of original evaluation logs from three systems. For RepairAgent, the study keeps main repair trajectories and excludes mutation sub-trajectories. For AutoCodeRover it uses V1 because later versions were unavailable, takes the first of three runs, and evaluates SWE-bench Lite instances. OpenHands contributes CodeAct SWE-bench Lite issue-resolution runs. The authors randomly sample 40 trajectories per agent with proportional selection of roughly 10 successful cases, but disclose neither the seed nor an immutable sampling-frame revision.

Parsing is agent-specific. RepairAgent and OpenHands provide structured JSON that requires tailored extraction. AutoCodeRover emits semi-structured output, so the parser heuristically detects tool calls, assigns preceding text as thought, and locates call results. The common analytical episode is an ordered sequence of thought, action, and result; released RQ1 CSVs also store instance_id, n_iterations, is_resolved, and token metrics. The release exposes several parsed pair views rather than a single canonical row schema.

Action analysis first maps known tools automatically, then manually inspects remaining actions. The final vocabulary has eight categories: Explore, Locate, Search, Reproduce, Generate Fix, Run tests, Refactor, and Explain. Actions that fit none of these classes—8.3%—are excluded from subsequent action analyses. The authors compare successful and failed trajectories through fixed-length action n-grams with n=4.

For semantic analysis, adjacent components are organized into five relation families: thought-action, thought-thought, action-action, result-thought, and result-action. Roughly 14,000 pairs are open-coded. The first author performs annotation over five months; both authors discuss the vocabulary, resolve ambiguous cases, cross-validate annotations, and revisit anomalies. The paper does not report a full double-coded fraction, numeric agreement result, adjudication log, or versioned guideline.

Terminal verification differs by substrate. AutoCodeRover and OpenHands use SWE-bench tests to decide whether the final patch resolves the issue. RepairAgent uses Defects4J plausibility followed by manual equality or semantic-equivalence checking against the developer patch. RepairAgent has a 40-iteration cap and OpenHands a 100-iteration cap; exact decoding parameters, retries, costs, and the AutoCodeRover/OpenHands backbone models used for these logs are unknown. Only RepairAgent's GPT-3.5 backbone is identified.

The outputs are trajectory statistics, parsed thought/action/result views, action-category CSVs, five families of semantic annotations, sequence-mining results, and successful/failed comparisons. Their supported use is evaluation and audit. No SFT, PRM, reward-model, RLVR, or agent-policy training is performed. Reproduction requires pinning agent and benchmark commits, raw logs, parser versions, selected instance manifests, environments, tool versions, reset semantics, annotation guidelines, and the repository snapshot; those pins are not all supplied.

输入池来自三种系统的原始评测日志。RepairAgent 只保留主修复轨迹并排除 mutation sub-trajectories；AutoCodeRover 因后续版本不可用而采用 V1，从三次运行中取第一次，并使用 SWE-bench Lite instance；OpenHands 提供 CodeAct 在 SWE-bench Lite 上的 issue-resolution 运行。作者对每个 agent 随机抽取 40 条轨迹，并按比例保留约 10 条成功案例，但没有披露随机种子或不可变 sampling-frame 版本。

解析器按 agent 定制。RepairAgent 与 OpenHands 提供结构化 JSON，但仍需专门抽取；AutoCodeRover 输出为半结构化格式，解析器启发式识别 tool call，把前置文本归为 thought，并定位 call result。统一分析 episode 是有序 thought、action、result 序列；公开 RQ1 CSV 还包含 instance_id、n_iterations、is_resolved 和 token 指标。发布提供多个解析后的 pair view，而不是单一 canonical row schema。

动作分析先自动映射已知工具，再人工检查其余 action。最终词表有八类：Explore、Locate、Search、Reproduce、Generate Fix、Run tests、Refactor、Explain。无法归入任何类别的 action 占 8.3%，并被排除在后续动作分析之外。成功与失败轨迹通过固定长度、n=4 的 action n-gram 进行比较。

语义分析把相邻组件分为五类关系：thought-action、thought-thought、action-action、result-thought、result-action，并对约 14,000 个 pair 做 open coding。第一作者用五个月完成标注；两位作者共同讨论标签体系、处理歧义、交叉检查标注并复查异常。论文没有报告完整 double-coded 比例、数值一致性、adjudication log 或版本化标注指南。

终止验证随 substrate 而异。AutoCodeRover 与 OpenHands 用 SWE-bench 测试判断最终补丁是否解决 issue；RepairAgent 先使用 Defects4J plausibility，再人工比对补丁是否与开发者补丁相同或语义等价。RepairAgent 的上限为 40 次迭代，OpenHands 为 100 次；精确解码参数、重试、成本，以及这些日志中 AutoCodeRover/OpenHands 的 backbone model 均为 unknown。论文只明确 RepairAgent 使用 GPT-3.5。

输出包括轨迹统计、解析后的 thought/action/result 视图、action-category CSV、五类语义标注、序列挖掘结果，以及成功/失败对比。证据支持的用途是 evaluation 和 audit；研究没有执行 SFT、PRM、reward-model、RLVR 或 agent-policy training。复现必须固定 agent/benchmark commit、raw logs、parser 版本、所选 instance 清单、environment、工具版本、reset semantics、标注指南和仓库快照，而这些信息尚未全部提供。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The empirical base is 120 trajectories containing 2,822 LLM interactions, evenly divided across RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover V1, and OpenHands CodeAct. The study intentionally includes success and failure: the official release lists 10 resolved and 30 unresolved instances per agent. This scale supports descriptive comparison of the sampled logs, not population-level claims about all software-engineering agents.

For RQ1, the paper reports mean trajectory lengths of 34 iterations for RepairAgent, 29 for OpenHands, and 6 for AutoCodeRover. Approximate mean total token counts are 220K, 1.2M, and 23K in the same agent order. These figures are conditioned on different agent architectures, task substrates, model identities, and iteration budgets; they do not isolate an architecture or model effect.

For RQ2, successful trajectories more often combine exploration, explanation, fix generation, and testing. Failed trajectories show repeated non-adaptive cycles and validation anti-patterns, including producing a fix without testing it. The authors derive these observations from the eight-way action coding and action 4-grams after excluding the 8.3% of actions that fit no category. The association is useful for diagnosis but does not establish that a motif causes success or failure.

For RQ3, the authors report that semantic misalignment is rare overall but appears more often in some failed trajectories; agent- and outcome-specific percentages are presented in Table II. The five relation families expose whether a thought motivates an action, whether successive thoughts/actions progress coherently, and whether a result is acknowledged or changes the next behavior. These are human-coded interpretations. No complete numeric reliability study is reported, so fine-grained label differences should not be treated as calibrated ground truth.

The official repository provides evidence that the analytical artifacts exist: per-agent parsed views, action-category CSVs, five annotation directories, RQ1 metrics, parsers, and successful/failed instance lists. A representative OpenHands record preserves a natural-language thought, tool name, and serialized arguments. This verifies the release shape, not immutable replay completeness.

The results are behavioral descriptions and design hypotheses. They do not demonstrate that the release is high-quality training data, that one agent is intrinsically better, or that the annotated patterns improve a trained model. Benchmark performance is used to label terminal outcomes; it is not proof of annotation reliability, release completeness, decontamination, or training value.

实证基础为 120 条轨迹、2,822 次 LLM interaction，平均分配给 RepairAgent、AutoCodeRover V1 和 OpenHands CodeAct。研究有意同时保留成功与失败：官方发布对每个 agent 各列出 10 条 resolved 和 30 条 unresolved instance。该规模支持对抽样日志进行描述性比较，但不足以代表所有软件工程 agent。

RQ1 报告的平均轨迹长度为 RepairAgent 34 次迭代、OpenHands 29 次、AutoCodeRover 6 次；按相同 agent 顺序，平均总 token 约为 220K、1.2M 和 23K。这些数字建立在不同 agent 架构、任务 substrate、模型身份和迭代预算上，不能单独识别架构或模型效应。

RQ2 中，成功轨迹更常组合 exploration、explanation、fix generation 与 testing；失败轨迹更常出现重复且不自适应的循环，以及生成修复后不测试等 validation anti-pattern。作者先做八类 action 编码和 action 4-gram，再得出这些观察；无法分类的 8.3% action 已被排除。该关联可用于诊断，但不能证明某个 motif 导致成功或失败。

RQ3 报告语义 misalignment 总体少见，但在部分失败轨迹中更常出现；Table II 给出了按 agent 和 outcome 划分的比例。五类关系用于检查 thought 是否推动 action、连续 thought/action 是否有进展，以及 result 是否被识别或改变后续行为。这些都是人工编码解释；论文没有完整的数值 reliability 研究，因此细粒度标签差异不应被当成校准后的 ground truth。

官方仓库证明相应分析工件确实存在：按 agent 划分的解析视图、action-category CSV、五类标注目录、RQ1 指标、parsers，以及成功/失败 instance 列表。一个代表性的 OpenHands 记录保留自然语言 thought、tool name 与序列化参数。这验证了发布形态，但不能证明其具备不可变 replay 所需的完整性。

上述结果是行为描述与设计假设。它们没有证明该发布是高质量训练数据，没有证明某个 agent 内在更优，也没有证明这些标注模式能提升训练后的模型。benchmark performance 只用于标记终止 outcome，不能替代 annotation reliability、release completeness、decontamination 或 training value 的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is terminal evaluation of individual software-repair agents: a benchmark records whether a generated patch passes tests or is accepted as correct, but that scalar outcome hides the sequence of reasoning, tool calls, observations, retries, and ignored feedback. Agent-log viewers expose interactions, and trajectory-learning methods can optimize from past runs, but neither alone supplies a common empirical coding scheme for comparing three heterogeneous software-engineering agents.

This paper changes the object of study from final patch outcome to the ordered thought-action-result episode. It normalizes RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover V1, and OpenHands CodeAct logs; introduces a shared eight-class action vocabulary; compares fixed action 4-grams; and open-codes five types of adjacency relations across roughly 14,000 component pairs. Keeping about 30 failures and 10 successes per agent makes failed adaptation and ignored feedback first-class analysis objects.

The feedback interface is also made explicit. Environment observations are separated from terminal success, and both are separated from human judgments about action type and semantic coherence. That distinction is useful for reasoning-data research because it prevents a test-passing label from being silently treated as step supervision and prevents human relation labels from being described as environment rewards.

What is not new includes the three agents, Defects4J and SWE-bench Lite tasks, their original terminal evaluators, tool-use logs, and general qualitative coding. The work does not introduce a new policy, replayable environment, benchmark split, reward model, or demonstrated training recipe. Its concrete novelty is the cross-agent empirical representation and annotation methodology applied to both successful and failed trajectories.

The direction signal is auditability below terminal reward: future releases can preserve state/action/observation fields, mark feedback uptake, and diagnose repeated unproductive loops. Before reuse, however, the community must verify that the published parser outputs match raw logs, the episode manifests match every analysis table, relation labels are reliable, and the release can be pinned and replayed. Scale and an award do not substitute for those checks.

既有基线通常是对单个软件修复 agent 做终止评测：benchmark 记录生成补丁是否通过测试或被确认正确，但这个标量 outcome 隐藏了推理、工具调用、observation、重试和被忽略反馈的序列。agent-log viewer 可以展示交互，从历史轨迹学习的方法可以执行优化，但二者本身都没有提供一套用于比较三种异构软件工程 agent 的统一实证编码方案。

本文把研究对象从最终补丁 outcome 改为有序 thought-action-result episode。它统一 RepairAgent、AutoCodeRover V1 与 OpenHands CodeAct 日志，建立共享的八类 action 词表，比较固定 action 4-gram，并对约 14,000 个组件 pair open-code 五类相邻关系。每个 agent 约保留 30 条失败和 10 条成功，使适应失败与忽略反馈成为一等分析对象。

反馈接口也被显式拆分：environment observation 与 terminal success 分开，二者又与 action 类型、语义一致性的人工判断分开。对 reasoning-data 研究而言，这一划分可避免把 test-passing 标签暗中当成 step supervision，也避免把人工关系标签描述成 environment reward。

非新内容包括三种 agent、Defects4J 与 SWE-bench Lite 任务、原始终止 evaluator、tool-use log 和一般 qualitative coding。研究没有提出新 policy、可重放 environment、新 benchmark split、reward model 或经过验证的 training recipe。其具体新意是把跨 agent 的实证表示与标注方法用于成功和失败轨迹。

该工作给出的方向信号是 terminal reward 以下的可审计性：未来发布可以保留 state/action/observation 字段，标记反馈是否被吸收，并诊断重复无效循环。但在复用前，仍需验证 parser 输出是否匹配 raw logs、episode 清单是否与每张分析表一致、关系标签是否可靠，以及发布能否被固定和 replay。规模与获奖信息不能替代这些检查。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The comparison is observational and heterogeneous. RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover, and OpenHands differ in architecture, backbone model, task suite, tools, terminal predicate, and iteration budget. Forty sampled runs per agent may miss rare behaviors, and the success-associated motifs do not establish causality. Only RepairAgent is tied to GPT-3.5 in this paper; the exact AutoCodeRover/OpenHands backbones and decoding settings are unknown.

Parsing and selection can distort the object. AutoCodeRover is parsed heuristically from semi-structured logs. Known tools are mapped automatically, remaining actions are manually inspected, and 8.3% of actions that fit no class are removed from subsequent action analysis. The exact random seed, sampling frame, and selection script for the 40 runs per agent are not disclosed, so another curator cannot reconstruct the same sample from the original evaluations.

Human annotation has unresolved reliability risk. Roughly 14,000 adjacent pairs were labeled through five months of first-author work plus joint discussion and partial agreement checks. The paper acknowledges subjectivity but supplies no numeric agreement statistic, complete double-coding fraction, adjudication log, or versioned guidelines. False coherence or misalignment labels can therefore alter claims about how agents use feedback.

The official release contains a specific cross-file inconsistency: rq1/repairagent_iterations.csv and the README/action-annotation lists each contain 10 successful and 30 failed RepairAgent entries, but the 30 failed instance names do not match. The repository does not explain which manifest underlies each paper figure or table. This is a lineage blocker, not a cosmetic naming issue.

Replay and versioning remain incomplete. The checked repository main was observed at commit 358870ec56aa38e9f221fd59c7078eb79b405cdf on 2026-01-23, after data-adding changes following arXiv v2. No GitHub release or immutable tag was verified. Parsed text and CSVs are public, but pinned containers, dependencies, source-repository revisions, agent/tool versions, reset semantics, checksums, and a raw-log replay manifest are not documented. Parser commands expect external raw inputs, and the README references a stats directory that was not visible in the verified root.

Rights and contamination also block training reuse. The repository has a root MIT License, but separate terms for benchmark issue text, source code, patches, generated thoughts, and tool outputs are not documented. The paper reports no decontamination or model-exposure audit for public SWE-bench Lite and Defects4J tasks. Completeness of raw terminal output, final patches, failed/invalid actions, and discarded material is unknown. These gaps justify evaluation/audit use only, not SFT, process supervision, reward modeling, RLVR, or agent training.

该比较是观察性的，而且三组条件异构。RepairAgent、AutoCodeRover 与 OpenHands 在架构、backbone model、任务集、工具、terminal predicate 和迭代预算上都不同。每个 agent 只抽样 40 条运行，可能遗漏罕见行为；与成功相关的 motif 也不能建立因果关系。论文只明确 RepairAgent 使用 GPT-3.5；AutoCodeRover/OpenHands 的精确 backbone 与解码设置为 unknown。

解析与选择可能扭曲数据对象。AutoCodeRover 从半结构化日志中启发式解析；已知工具自动映射，其余 action 人工检查，无法归类的 8.3% action 被移出后续动作分析。论文没有披露每个 agent 抽取 40 条运行所用的随机种子、sampling frame 与 selection script，因此其他研究者无法从原始评测中重建同一批样本。

人工标注仍有 reliability 风险。约 14,000 个相邻 pair 经第一作者五个月标注，再由双方讨论并进行 partial agreement checks。论文承认主观性，但没有提供数值一致性、完整 double-coding 比例、adjudication log 或版本化指南。错误的 coherence/misalignment 标签可能改变关于 agent 如何利用反馈的结论。

官方发布存在明确的跨文件不一致：rq1/repairagent_iterations.csv 与 README/action-annotation 列表都包含 10 条成功、30 条失败 RepairAgent 记录，但 30 条失败 instance 名称并不一致。仓库没有解释每张论文图表使用了哪个清单。这是 lineage blocker，不是表面命名问题。

replay 与版本固定仍不完整。已检查的 repository main 在 2026-01-23 指向 commit 358870ec56aa38e9f221fd59c7078eb79b405cdf，其中包含 arXiv v2 之后新增数据的变更；未验证到 GitHub release 或不可变 tag。公开内容包括解析文本与 CSV，但没有固定 container、dependency、source-repository revision、agent/tool 版本、reset semantics、checksum 或 raw-log replay manifest。parser 命令依赖外部 raw input，README 引用的 stats 目录也未出现在已验证根目录中。

权利与污染问题同样阻止训练复用。仓库根目录有 MIT License，但 benchmark issue text、source code、patch、生成 thought 与 tool output 的独立条款未说明。论文没有对公开 SWE-bench Lite 与 Defects4J 任务进行 decontamination 或模型暴露审计。raw terminal output、final patch、failed/invalid action 与被丢弃材料是否完整均为 unknown。因此只支持 evaluation/audit，不支持 SFT、process supervision、reward modeling、RLVR 或 agent training。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within environment_agent_trajectory_data, this work is a concrete audit recipe for turning otherwise opaque software-agent logs into an inspectable episode ledger. A maintainer can separate task and benchmark provenance, thought, tool/action and arguments, result/observation, terminal outcome, action category, feedback-use relation, iteration/token budget, and success/failure retention. That schema is useful even when the original agents cannot be rerun.

For evaluation design, the paper shows why terminal patch success should be paired with process diagnostics. Repeated identical actions, fix-without-test behavior, ignored tool results, and thought-action misalignment can be measured as failure indicators rather than hidden in a single resolved bit. A derivative study can preregister these labels, double-code a subset, report agreement, and test whether the indicators generalize across agent and repository families.

For release audits, the Card suggests an executable checklist: publish one machine-readable episode manifest; retain raw and parsed logs plus failures; bind every analysis row to an instance and artifact hash; pin agent, model, benchmark, repository, tool, and parser revisions; specify reset and terminal predicates; release annotation guidelines and adjudication; reconcile lists across RQ outputs; and declare data-specific rights. These checks directly answer the track's questions about state/action/observation structure, failure preservation, and replayability.

The appropriate reuse class is evaluation/audit reference only. The released annotations can support exploratory behavior analysis after rights and manifest review, but the evidence does not establish safe training reuse. In particular, relationship labels are not process rewards, test-passing outcomes do not validate intermediate reasoning, and the paper reports no SFT, PRM, RLVR, reward-model, or policy-training experiment.

A stronger follow-up would reproduce the 120-episode sample from pinned raw logs, preserve the 8.3% uncategorized actions as an explicit rejection set, resolve the RepairAgent manifest conflict, publish numeric inter-annotator agreement, and replay episodes under fixed environments. It should also keep evaluation tasks separated from any later training conversion and audit exposure to SWE-bench Lite and Defects4J.

在 environment_agent_trajectory_data 轨道中，这项工作提供了一套具体审计配方，可把原本不透明的软件 agent 日志转换为可检查的 episode ledger。维护者可以分别记录任务与 benchmark provenance、thought、tool/action 及参数、result/observation、terminal outcome、action category、反馈利用关系、迭代/token 预算，以及成功/失败保留情况。即使原 agent 无法重跑，这套 schema 仍有价值。

对 evaluation design 而言，论文说明 terminal patch success 应与 process diagnostic 配套。重复相同行为、生成 fix 后不测试、忽略 tool result、thought-action misalignment 都可以作为 failure indicator 测量，而不是隐藏在单个 resolved bit 中。衍生研究可预注册标签、对一部分样本 double-code、报告 agreement，并测试这些指标能否跨 agent 与仓库族泛化。

对 release audit 而言，本卡给出可执行清单：发布一份 machine-readable episode manifest；同时保留 raw/parsed log 与失败样本；把每条分析记录绑定到 instance 和 artifact hash；固定 agent、model、benchmark、repository、tool 与 parser revision；说明 reset 与 terminal predicate；公开 annotation guideline 与 adjudication；核对各 RQ 输出中的清单；声明数据特定权利。这些检查直接对应本轨道关心的 state/action/observation 结构、failure preservation 与 replayability。

合适的复用等级是仅作为 evaluation/audit reference。完成权利与清单审查后，公开标注可用于探索性行为分析，但现有证据不能支持安全训练复用。特别是，relationship label 不是 process reward，test-passing outcome 不能验证中间推理，论文也没有 SFT、PRM、RLVR、reward-model 或 policy-training 实验。

更强的后续工作应从固定 raw logs 重建 120 个 episode，把 8.3% uncategorized action 作为显式 rejection set 保留，解决 RepairAgent 清单冲突，发布数值 inter-annotator agreement，并在固定 environment 中 replay episode。若之后把轨迹转为训练数据，还必须与 evaluation task 严格隔离，并审计对 SWE-bench Lite 与 Defects4J 的暴露。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Definitions 1 and 4 with Sections II-B–II-F: the object is a thought-action-result episode, while tool observations, terminal success, action categories, and semantic relations are four different kinds of signal.
  • Keep the scale exact: 3 agents × 40 trajectories = 120 episodes and 2,822 iterations; the release lists about 10 resolved and 30 unresolved cases per agent.
  • Keep the taxonomies exact: eight action categories, five adjacent-component relation families, action 4-grams, and 8.3% uncategorized actions excluded from later action analysis.
  • Read the behavioral findings as associations, not causal proof or evidence of training-data quality; agent architectures, models, tasks, terminal predicates, and budgets differ.
  • Before reuse, resolve the RepairAgent manifest mismatch and verify a tagged snapshot, raw-log replay path, annotation agreement, dataset/upstream rights, and decontamination.

• 应把 Definition 1、Definition 4 与第 II-B–II-F 节对照阅读：数据对象是 thought-action-result episode，而 tool observation、terminal success、action category 与 semantic relation 是四种不同信号。
  • 规模必须写准：3 个 agent × 每个 40 条轨迹 = 120 个 episode、2,822 次迭代；发布对每个 agent 列出约 10 条 resolved 和 30 条 unresolved case。
  • 分类必须写准：八类 action、五类相邻组件关系、action 4-gram，以及被排除在后续动作分析之外的 8.3% uncategorized action。
  • 行为发现只能解释为关联，不能当成因果证明或训练数据质量证据；agent 架构、模型、任务、terminal predicate 与预算均不同。
  • 复用前应解决 RepairAgent 清单不一致，并验证 tagged snapshot、raw-log replay 路径、annotation agreement、数据/上游权利与 decontamination。

value.html: A 120-episode analysis sample: 40 RepairAgent bug-repair runs over Defects4J, 40 AutoCodeRover V1 issue-resolution runs over SWE-bench Lite, and 40 OpenHands CodeAct runs over SWE-bench Lite. The paper reports random sampling with about 10 successful episodes per agent; the official repository lists 10 resolved and 30 unresolved instances per agent, but does not disclose the random seed.

Per-instance software-agent episode material is released across parsed text views and CSV annotations rather than one normalized row: ordered thought/action/result components, tool names and arguments, action categories, five adjacent-component relationship families, iteration/token metrics, instance ID, and a resolved label. A standalone final-patch field and replay manifest were not verified.

RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover V1, and OpenHands CodeAct generate the trajectories. The paper identifies GPT-3.5 for RepairAgent; the AutoCodeRover and OpenHands backbone models used for these logs are not disclosed in this paper.

Defects4J for RepairAgent and SWE-bench Lite for AutoCodeRover/OpenHands, with agent-specific code-editing, shell, search, and test tools. The release does not document pinned containers, source-repository commits, dependency locks, or reset semantics sufficient for immutable replay.

AutoCodeRover and OpenHands success is a patch passing SWE-bench tests. RepairAgent first requires a Defects4J-plausible patch and then manual confirmation that it equals or is semantically equivalent to the developer patch. Action and semantic-relation labels are human-coded analytical annotations, not a trained reward.

Binary episode success from the original agent evaluation: SWE-bench test-passing patch for AutoCodeRover/OpenHands; Defects4J plausible-and-manually-correct patch for RepairAgent. Otherwise the episode is unresolved or ends at the agent budget.
RepairAgent uses GPT-3.5 according to the paper. The specific backbone models for the AutoCodeRover V1 and OpenHands CodeAct trajectories are unknown in this study.
unknown
RepairAgent main trajectories, AutoCodeRover V1 first-run trajectories, and OpenHands CodeAct issue-resolution trajectories, each parsed into a common thought-action-result representation.

Random 40-per-agent subsampling from the original evaluation logs with proportional success sampling, followed by tailored parsers, trajectory statistics, eight-way action coding, frequent 4-gram mining, and open coding of five semantic-relation families. Seed and exact sampling-frame revision are unknown.
120 trajectories containing 2,822 iterations/LLM interactions
unknown

Ignore RepairAgent mutation sub-trajectories; use AutoCodeRover V1 because later versions were unavailable and select the first of its three runs; randomly retain 40 trajectories per agent with roughly 10 successes. Map known tools to eight action classes, manually inspect remaining actions, and exclude the 8.3% that fit no class from subsequent action analyses.

RepairAgent caps trajectories at 40 iterations and OpenHands at 100; AutoCodeRover has a short retrieve-locate-fix workflow. Exact decoding, retry, wall-clock, model, and per-run cost budgets are unknown.

No policy optimizer is used. The analytical scaffold consists of agent-specific parsers, trajectory/token statistics, eight-way action categorization, fixed 4-gram sequence mining, and manual open coding of semantic relationships.

40 trajectories each from RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover V1, and OpenHands CodeAct; 80 SWE-bench Lite issue-resolution episodes and 40 Defects4J repair episodes, with 10 resolved and 30 unresolved instances listed per agent in the release.
No train/dev/test split is defined; this is an analysis sample. The exact random seed and an immutable sampled-instance manifest shared across every analysis file are not provided.
All AutoCodeRover/OpenHands tasks come from public SWE-bench Lite and all RepairAgent tasks from Defects4J. The paper does not report model decontamination or public-benchmark exposure checks.
unknown

Both outcomes are represented: the repository lists 10 resolved and 30 unresolved instances per agent. However, 8.3% of uncategorizable actions are excluded from subsequent action analyses, and completeness of original raw logs is unknown.

items: Manual action and semantic-relation coding is subjective; the paper reports collaboration and partial agreement checks but no complete double-coding protocol or numeric agreement statistic.
Agent architectures, underlying models, task suites, terminal predicates, and iteration budgets differ, so cross-agent performance or cost differences are not clean causal comparisons.
Forty trajectories per agent can miss rare behaviors, and reported associations between motifs and success do not establish causality.
AutoCodeRover parsing is heuristic, and excluding 8.3% uncategorizable actions can bias action-pattern results toward parser-friendly behavior.
RepairAgent RQ1 instance IDs do not fully match the README and action-annotation instance lists; the official artifacts do not explain which manifest underlies each paper result.
No verified tagged release, checksums, machine-readable data card, pinned environments, source-repository commits, or replay/reset manifest was verified.
Public SWE-bench Lite and Defects4J tasks may have been exposed to the underlying models; no decontamination analysis is reported.
The repository README references analysis scripts under stats/, but that directory was not visible in the verified root tree; full reproduction requires another immutable-clone check.
A repository-level MIT license does not by itself settle upstream data and generated-trace rights for unrestricted training reuse.
